status: Build 3: Fernbrook glimmer scenes plus the Bright Pavilion Tour (Hall slot 1). Slot 2 is not in this build.
_about: The Glimmerwell branch of Act 1. Same shapes as the other data files. A scene X@glimmer runs instead of X while story.side is glimmer; a trainer id@glimmer is merged over id. The branch sets the same progression flags as the Keepers path. No new maps.
_wiring: Standing steps (sp_pick, orchard_g, seal1_g, tour1_match) and the seal step are engine grants kept with the delivered lines. Tour completion is seal1@glimmer, so seal1_g is granted once there. tour1_match (+5) runs only when trainer.hall1_fen is already set, which is the optional match win. The Keepers confirm label dropped its final question mark so the label stays within 30 characters.

_decisions.hall_slot_1: Tour. Vincent, Oct 13, 2026: slot 1 stays the stated default (Bright Pavilion Tour). The Audit battle is optional stop 4.
_decisions.hall_slot_2: Sacrifice, with Quota as the free floor. Not built in Build 3.
_decisions.rook_r5: Keepers path: Rook eventually converts to good. Glimmerwell path: Rook stays with Glimmerwell. Not bond-gated, and there is no follow-or-stay fork. The R5 scene is not in this build. teaser@glimmer does not say he leaves.

Tour stop 3, the Trial Hall doorstep (the pavilion rented for the day). Stop 4 is the Hall panel once this flag is set.

side_pick: Crates line the orchard path. Tobin hums by the stack. Master Fen waits under the first apple tree.
{name}, my Pomlets have rooted here since the first blossom. Help me open these crates?
No lanterns, no lanyards. Just a keeper's hands and a little patience.
Hi hi! Don't mind us. We're relocating these little ones to a lovely Comfort Sanctuary.
Tired is just relaxed with bad lighting! They'll nap under soft lamps. Clean energy, all round.
Help us pack and we'll sign you up for a Junior Bright trial lanyard. Today only!
A lanyard is a ribbon, {name}. Roots are a promise. Choose what you can carry.
This decides who you travel with for a while. You can change course later, but it will cost you.
Then we grow together. Tobin won't listen to me. He might listen to a keeper with a strong team.
Aw. No hard feelings! The trial lanyard offer stays open. Have a bright day!
And if your path ever bends, the Lantern House keeps a door open. Paths do bend.
You step back from the gate. The orchard can wait a moment.
Yay! Welcome to the partnership, {name}! Brighter by nature.
Grab that crate lid, trainee. First rule: always smile at the units.
...I see. The Lantern House door stays open, {name}. It always has.
You step back from the gate. The orchard can wait a moment.
You step back from the gate. Nobody is in a hurry but the crates.
orchard@glimmer: Tobin hands you a crate lid with a mint bow on it. Juniper sets a Glimmer lantern by the stack.
Easy does it. Lantern goes in first. They love the hum. Watch!
A Pomlet sniffs the lantern, yawns, and curls up. Its leaves look a shade paler. Probably the light.
Aw, see? That's a happy unit. Comfier already.
You're a natural! Put that on your review.
First-day nerves! It gets easier. Mostly.
Three crates, all snug. Quarterly targets, here we come!
These trees will blossom without them this spring. I hoped a keeper's hands would know better.
Comfy. Roots don't need comfy. They need home.
Sorry is a seed. We'll see what it grows into.
Go on. Come to the Hall if you must. I'll stand for the orchard there.
Fen walks to the Hall without looking back. The cart rolls off toward the pavilion.
Great work! Head to the Hall for your partnership review. Have a bright day!
seal1@glimmer: Review complete! Here's your Bright Tier 1 Lanyard. Clip it on, partner!
Welcome snacks, too! Units and keepers both run better on snacks.
Wear it everywhere. People trust mint. Brighter by nature!
teaser@glimmer: You got your Tier 1? Took you long enough. I'm going for Bright of the Month.
Imogen says the Route 2 Census needs volunteers. First one there gets the good clipboard.
Race you! ...Hey. Did those Pomlets look kind of grey to you? Never mind. Lighting.
Route 2 is open now. Keep heading east!
